_note: Scoring for tonight's ranking. Edit the numbers here; no code change is needed. A player's star power is the sum over the seasons below of (season weight x points), and awards in the same season stack. Only players on tonight's rosters who are not listed Out or Doubtful count. Awards come from data/recent_awards.json.

stakes._note: A game gets a stakes score only when both teams have played at least min_games. stakes = win_pct_points x (away win % + home win %), plus close_bonus when the two win percentages are within close_within of each other.

_heading_note: The tonight page switches its heading to the stakes wording when stakes are on for more than this share of the day's games.
